Game Overview

In Pumpkin Doodle, the core idea is straightforward: explore the spooky world of Pumpkin Doodle, where pumpkin Jack navigates haunted paths, collecting treasures while dodging lurking ghosts. With simplistic controls, players must use sharp reflexes and strategic movement to protect the Spirit of Halloween. Quick thinking and speed are key in this suspenseful arcade adventure!
